properties.name: monthFormat
properties.description: How the month names should be formatted in the select options.

properties.name: months
properties.description:
An array of month numbers (1-12) to display in the select.
This allows for flexible month selection, such as showing only
specific months or seasons.

properties.name: yearFormat
properties.description: How the year should be formatted in the select options.

properties.name: years
properties.description:
An array of years to display in the select.
This allows for complete control over which years appear,
such as showing only years with data or excluding certain periods.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description:
The placeholder date, used to control the view of the
calendar when no value is present.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Whether or not the calendar is disabled.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The value of the selected date range.

properties.name: readonly
properties.description:
Whether the calendar is readonly. When true, the user will be able
to focus and navigate the calendar, but will not be able to select
dates.

properties.name: onValueChange
properties.description: A callback function called when the value changes.

properties.name: onPlaceholderChange
properties.description:
A callback function called when the placeholder value
changes.

properties.name: preventDeselect
properties.description:
Whether or not users can deselect a date once selected
without selecting another date.

properties.name: minValue
properties.description: The minimum date that can be selected in the calendar.

properties.name: maxValue
properties.description: The maximum date that can be selected in the calendar.

properties.name: pagedNavigation
properties.description: Applicable only when `numberOfMonths` is greater than 1.

properties.name: weekStartsOn
properties.description:
The day of the week to start the calendar on, which must
be a number between 0 and 6, where 0 is Sunday and 6 is
Saturday.

properties.name: weekdayFormat
properties.description:
How the string representation of the weekdays provided via the `weekdays` state store
should be formatted.

properties.name: isDateDisabled
properties.description:
A function that receives a date and returns `true` or `false` to indicate whether
the date is disabled.

properties.name: isDateUnavailable
properties.description:
Dates matching the provided matchers are marked as "unavailable." Unlike disabled dates,
users can still focus and select unavailable dates. However, selecting an unavailable date
renders the date picker as invalid.

properties.name: fixedWeeks
properties.description:
Display 6 weeks per month, regardless the month's number of weeks.
This is useful for displaying a consistent calendar, where the size
of the calendar doesn't change month to month.

properties.name: numberOfMonths
properties.description:
Determines the number of months to display on the calendar simultaneously.
For navigation between months, refer to the `pagedNavigation` prop.

properties.name: calendarLabel
properties.description:
This label is exclusively used for accessibility, remaining hidden from the page.
It's read by screen readers when the calendar is opened. The current month and year
are automatically appended to the label, so you only need to provide the base label.

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The default locale setting.

properties.name: disableDaysOutsideMonth
properties.description:
Whether to disable the selection of days outside the current month. By default,
days outside the current month are rendered to fill the calendar grid, but they
are not selectable. Setting this prop to `true` will disable this behavior.

properties.name: maxDays
properties.description: The maximum number of days that can be selected in a range.

properties.name: monthFormat
properties.description: The format of the month names in the calendar.

properties.name: yearFormat
properties.description: The format of the year names in the calendar.

properties.name: onStartValueChange
properties.description:
A callback function called when the start value changes. This doesn't necessarily mean
the `value` has updated and should be used to apply cosmetic changes to the calendar when
only part of the value is changed/completed.

properties.name: onEndValueChange
properties.description:
A callback function called when the end value changes. This doesn't necessarily mean
the `value` has updated and should be used to apply cosmetic changes to the calendar when
only part of the value is changed/completed.

properties.name: minDays
properties.description: The minimum number of days that can be selected in a range.

properties.name: excludeDisabled
properties.description:
Whether to automatically reset the range if any date within the selected range
becomes disabled. When true, the entire range will be cleared if a disabled
date is found between the start and end dates.

properties.name: date
properties.description: The date value of the cell.

properties.name: month
properties.description: The month DateValue that this cell is being rendered in.

properties.name: month
properties.type: { value: DateValue; weeks: DateValue[][]; dates: DateValue[]; }
